title: Scene Attraction Graph
description: Scene graph from objects and attractions: wormhole roots per component, multi-parent resolves to closer-to-wormhole owner, central object state with id-only React components, child survives parent destroy on reparent.
summary: Implemented central scene object state (SceneObjectStateProvider) with resolved attraction ownership: wormhole roots per component, multi-parent picks attractor closer to wormhole. React renders id-keyed SceneObjects flat for stable instances on reparent; ObjectTreeNode/SceneAttractionTreeRoots declare tree structure; translate relocate cascades to attracted descendants. Fixed parent-distance bug (use completed BFS dist map). parseFixtureV1 reads attractions or legacy ties field. Play and topology panes use new providers.
